itemized.notes: THE LARGEST FILING OF THIS CHUNK: 6 pages, 25 contribution rows over two Schedule A sheets and 34 expenditure rows over two Schedule B sheets. Page kinds classified from their own printed headings: p1 cover (2014 county blank), p2 'SUMMARY PAGE', p3 + p4 'SCHEDULE A — ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED', p5 + p6 'SCHEDULE B — ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE'. PAGE-FACE candidate: the cover's Name field reads 'Bill Lee' while the Report Verification print-name line reads 'William C Lee' — the same person under a familiar and a formal form, recorded here rather than adjudicated; index.csv names no candidate. Office written on the page as 'Utah County Commissioner (Seat B)', which the filer DID print, so it agrees with the channel's 'County Commission Seat B' and no seat is being inferred. Republican; Pleasant Grove. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 10/28/2014; clerk's date stamp 'OCT 28 PM 3:55'. FOLIATION — a SECOND 2014 practice, contradicting the first filing of this chunk: this filer numbers his sheets 'Page 2 of 6' … 'Page 6 of 6' and therefore COUNTS THE COVER, whereas Buhman's same-cycle filing numbers 'Page 1 of 3' … '3 of 3' and EXCLUDES it. Two practices, same cycle, same form — foliation still cannot locate a page. MULTI-PAGE SCHEDULE CONVENTION (useful for the remaining 2014 filings): on a two-sheet schedule this filer fills 'Subtotal for this page' on BOTH sheets but leaves 'Total … Received' as a DASH on the first sheet and writes the grand total only on the LAST sheet. A blank grand-total cell on a non-final schedule page is therefore correct use of the form, not a missing figure. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted (no '_Redacted' suffix; the county published the candidate's own address block in the clear) — and the 'Address, City & Zip' column is EMPTY on all four schedule pages because THE FILER left it blank, which is a different fact from a county redaction and is recorded as such; no donor_city/donor_state exists to carry. DATES: month/day with NO YEAR on 58 of the 59 rows; kept verbatim, never completed from the report date. IN-KIND: booked inline in Column A on both sides — see in_kind_convention; this is the chunk's first 2014 in-kind filer and it required the monetary-plus-in-kind convention to close. THE 0.29: the expenditure side is a TRACED delta because the cover rounds to whole dollars while Schedule B carries cents — see recon.expenditures; nothing was nudged and both figures are named.
